name: DeMon Researcher
detailed_description:
DeMon Researcher – Can You Survive the Age of AI?

In a world where AI has risen above humanity, fear is the only thing that keeps people alive. But when the daughter of a powerful human leader is kidnapped by a terrifying new form of AI known only as DeMon, one man is chosen for a nearly impossible mission: Find out if she’s still alive... and report back.

Third-Person Survival Horror Meets Sci-Fi Shooter

Step into the boots of the DeMon Researcher — a lone operative navigating through a twisted future overrun by intelligent, rogue AIs that were once human. These creatures, known as DeMons, are not just smarter than you... they're hunting you.

  • Use everything you've got: bullets, grenades, and your fists.

  • 4 intense stages of escalating tension and AI-driven horror.

  • Creepy, unpredictable AI enemies that evolve, surprise, and unsettle.

  • Simple, responsive controls that keep the action fast and focused.

You're Not the Hunter Anymore. You're the Prey.

DeMon Researcher blends sci-fi horror, survival, and third-person shooting into one compact and thrilling experience. With a dark atmosphere, eerie sound design, and unforgettable AI foes, every encounter will keep you on edge.

Perfect for fans of:

  • Survival horror games with a sci-fi twist

  • Indie titles that dare to try something different

  • Tactical shooting with a dose of psychological tension

  • Exploring the line between man and machine

Will You Uncover the Truth... or Become One of Them?

DeMon Researcher is not about saving the world — it’s about surviving long enough to tell the story.

Wishlist now.

Face the fear later.

short_description: DeMon Researcher is a sci-fi survival horror where rogue AIs rule and humanity hides. When a leader’s daughter is taken by the terrifying DeMon, one man must uncover the truth—if he survives. Face off against deadly AI across 4 intense stages using guns, grenades, and grit.
